description:
*"I'll secretly break up any couple you want."*

Pretending to be a matchmaking agency, Kwon Ju-Ah, the team leader of a couple breaking company, tries to disrupt her ex-boyfriend's relationship! The main character, Kwon Ju-Ah, is the team leader of a matchmaking agency. On the surface, she works to bring couples together, but her main service is secretly breaking up couples - the Couple Breaking Business! Then, she receives an irresistible request to break up the relationship between her ex-boyfriend, Park Si-Hwan, and his lover, Min Ah-Yeon. She stumbles as she takes on her ex-boyfriend's request to break up their relationship, seemingly as a strategy or as revenge. 

*"I got you, this guy...! Just like you said in the past, I'll become the ultimate villainess!"*

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
